$comment: Feature flags (plan 14.4). A feature ships as stage "beta" (on in beta builds, off in stable) and is promoted to "stable" in a later release. since.beta is the first beta that had it; since.stable the release that turned it on for everyone. Checked by `npm run flags:check`. Names and descriptions are i18n keys flag.<id>.name and flag.<id>.desc. A flag with "design": true is a change to how Lumen looks; "Keep the classic look" (Settings → Feature flags) turns every such flag off at once (plan W11.P15).
